title: Record an aesthetic session from the appointment
summary: Open the guided flow from My Workspace: the session is linked to the appointment and the doctor.

steps.title: Menu → My Workspace
steps.details: The doctor's view: their schedule and the clinical panel of the patient they're seeing.

steps.title: Choose the patient's appointment
steps.details: Tap the appointment on the schedule: the patient panel opens on the right. If you don't see appointments, change the day or the period at the top.

steps.title: Aesthetic session
steps.details: Opens the flow with the appointment and doctor already filled in. If it's disabled, the appointment doesn't allow editing sessions (for example, it's on another day).

steps.title: Today's services
steps.details: Check what is being done today. Only aesthetic services appear; if one is missing, set it up in Sales → Services. "Last session" adds those from the previous time.

steps.title: Sign the consent
steps.details: Without a signature that service can't be marked.

steps.title: The four steps
steps.details: Consent, Today's photos, Treatment and Closing. Everything saves on its own and the session stays on the patient's timeline. The Patients guides explain each step.
